intro: You've searched for natural IVF near you, so you're likely exploring a gentler approach to fertility treatment that uses little or no stimulation medication. Natural IVF collects one or a few eggs per cycle, and whether it suits you depends on your own circumstances. We can introduce you to a UK fertility clinic that offers natural IVF, and they will quote you directly.

context_heading: Understanding natural IVF and clinic licensing
context: Natural IVF uses little or no stimulation medication, so only one or a few eggs are collected each cycle. This means fewer eggs than conventional IVF, and success rates for natural IVF are generally lower per cycle. Suitability depends on your individual situation, so a consultation with a clinic is important.

Any clinic offering IVF, donor treatment, egg and embryo freezing or most other fertility treatments must be licensed by the HFEA. You can check a clinic's inspection ratings, success rates and patient feedback using the HFEA's Choose a Fertility Clinic tool. Simple blood hormone tests may be offered outside HFEA licensing, but treatment involving eggs, sperm or embryos should always be with a licensed centre.

questions_heading: Questions to ask the fertility clinic
questions: Is this clinic licensed by the HFEA for natural IVF?

What costs are involved, and what does the quote include?

faqs.q: Is natural IVF as successful as conventional IVF?
faqs.a: Natural IVF collects fewer eggs per cycle, so success rates per cycle are generally lower than with conventional IVF. However, it may be suitable for some people, and a clinic can advise on your individual chances.

faqs.q: Do I need to be licensed by the HFEA to offer natural IVF?
faqs.a: Yes, any clinic offering IVF, including natural IVF, must be licensed by the HFEA. You can check a clinic's licence and inspection ratings using the HFEA's Choose a Fertility Clinic tool.

faqs.q: How do I find a natural IVF clinic near me?
faqs.a: You can use the HFEA's Choose a Fertility Clinic tool to find licensed clinics in your area. Alternatively, tell iComply your location and needs, and we can introduce you to a suitable clinic.

faqs.q: What should I expect at my first consultation for natural IVF?
faqs.a: At a first consultation, the clinic will discuss your medical history, your options and what natural IVF involves. They will also be able to give you a personalised quote.
